flavorText: NSLOCTEXT("[70199B914E7E03A9706A1499CF20B1FD]", "02388EFC4B7392730B28FCA3B99F1306", "In a matter of heartbeats, I\'ve left Sanctus and the world I knew behind for the promised wonders of Verra. The power of essence surrounds me. The Restoration\'s Hammer seeks to reclaim the ancient Dunzenkell Mountainhall as the seat of Dunir power. They\'ve established Hammer Rest to the east, but progress has met resistance.Gatewatcher Borin Stonebeard has tasked me with reaching Gritstone Overwatch, a forward post on the road to Hammer Rest. The commander there, Gretta Ironhand, holds the line against corrupted Automata grabber machines, now hostile and relentless. Strange Clay Dwarves have also been spotted, but their intent remains unclear. I must report to her.")
mainObjectiveText: NSLOCTEXT("[70199B914E7E03A9706A1499CF20B1FD]", "22B584F14626B7194740E6AA6C9B9896", "Make your way to Commander Ironhand and if possible, help along the way..")
name: ANV_FTUE_HR_0001_TheBrokenLine
